settings.text: Type a word, or scroll. Everything about buying, using and changing a template.

settings.question: Do I need a paid Notion plan?
settings.answer: No. Every template works on Notion's free plan. You only need an account.

settings.question: How do I get the template after I pay?
settings.answer: Your receipt has a link to the template. Open it while signed in to Notion and press Duplicate. It is in your workspace a few seconds later.

settings.question: Can I change it?
settings.answer: Yes. Once you duplicate it, it is your page. Rename columns, add properties, change the colours, delete what you do not use.

settings.question: Does it work on my phone?
settings.answer: Yes. It works anywhere Notion does: the Mac and Windows apps, the browser, and the iPhone and Android apps.

settings.question: Can I share it with my team?
settings.answer: You can share your copy inside your own workspace. Please do not resell it or post the duplicate link publicly.

settings.question: What if it is not right for me?
settings.answer: Write within 14 days and you get your money back. No form, just reply to your receipt.

settings.question: Is there a bundle?
settings.answer: Not yet. If you buy two templates and want a third, write to me and I will send a discount code.

settings.question: Can I use it for a client?
settings.answer: Yes, you can set it up inside a client's workspace for them. Each client needs their own copy.

settings.question: Do you make custom templates?
settings.answer: Sometimes, between new templates. Write with what you need and when, and I will tell you honestly if I can help.

settings.name: Adda Lind
settings.heading: Ask me anything about the templates
settings.text: I answer every message myself, usually within two working days. If you are not sure which template fits, tell me how your week looks.
